ideas.title: One daily plan that adjusts to how you've recovered
ideas.body: Each morning Udapt reads your sleep, heart rate variability and resting heart rate from Apple Health, or asks a 5-question check-in, and adjusts today's training and food targets together, explaining every change in plain English.

ideas.title: Readiness compared with your own normal
ideas.body: A readiness score out of 10, compared with your own usual numbers, never with other people's. On a rough morning you get fewer sets and a lighter effort, with the original session one tap away.

ideas.title: Gym and home programmes with how-tos
ideas.body: Full programmes for the gym or home (dumbbells and bodyweight), set-by-set logging, how-to photos and instructions for each exercise, and progress charts for every lift.

ideas.title: Protect a shoulder, knee or lower back
ideas.body: Tell Udapt which joint you're being careful with and it swaps out exercises that load it.

ideas.title: Food targets that follow your training
ideas.body: Calorie, protein, carb and fat targets: a little more on training days, a little less on rest days, with the week's total unchanged. Search over 14,000 foods, scan a barcode, or describe a meal or snap a photo with Apple Intelligence.

ideas.title: Apple Watch app, widgets and Siri
ideas.body: Today's plan and set logging on Apple Watch with a rest timer and a readiness complication, Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets, a Live Activity while you train, and Siri for "How ready am I?".

ideas.title: Private by design
ideas.body: No account, no ads and no third-party analytics. Your health data stays in Apple Health and everything Udapt keeps stays on your phone.
